results.dataset: Australia and New Zealand first acute stroke (Peng et al. Stroke 2022)
results.notes: Published cohort: base layer, stroke only, averaged over a normal age distribution with the published mean and SD (ages 18-100) and the cohort's sex mix. The stroke hazard ratio describes people with a history of stroke, so early deaths after an acute stroke are expected to be underpredicted.
